data.one_liner: Detects browser and OS types and versions in Dart web apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides runtime detection of the browser and operating system, exposing boolean flags like browser.isChrome or operatingSystem.isMac. It can also add CSS classes to the <html> element for styling based on platform features.
use_when: You need to adapt UI or behavior based on the user's browser or OS.
You want to add platform‑specific CSS classes for styling or analytics.
You need simple feature detection such as touch support.
avoid_when: You are building a non‑web Flutter app (mobile or desktop).
You need advanced feature detection beyond touch/mstouch.
strengths: Simple API with clear boolean flags.
Can decorate the <html> element for CSS styling.
Supports custom feature detection via Feature objects.
weaknesses: Only works on web; no support for mobile/desktop Flutter.
Feature detection limited to touch/mstouch unless extended manually.
No version ranges beyond simple checks.
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec and import package: import 'package:platform_detect/platform_detect.dart';
